hooks.command: sh -lc 'export PYTHONUTF8=1; repo_root="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" || exit $?; if [ -x "$repo_root/.venv/bin/python" ]; then exec "$repo_root/.venv/bin/python" "$repo_root/scripts/stop_hook.py"; fi; exec python3 "$repo_root/scripts/stop_hook.py"'
hooks.commandWindows: powershell -NoProfile -NonInteractive -Command "$env:PYTHONUTF8 = '1'; $repoRoot = git rev-parse --show-toplevel; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; $projectPython = Join-Path $repoRoot '.venv/Scripts/python.exe'; if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $projectPython -PathType Leaf) { & $projectPython (Join-Path $repoRoot 'scripts/stop_hook.py'); exit $LASTEXITCODE }; py -3 (Join-Path $repoRoot 'scripts/stop_hook.py'); exit $LASTEXITCODE"
